from collections import Counter
import pathlib
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    hcuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vcuts = [c for c in range(cols) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(rows)}) == 1]
    hcuts = [r for r in hcuts if 0 < r < rows - 1]
    vcuts = [c for c in vcuts if 0 < c < cols - 1]
    row_edges = [-1] + hcuts + [rows]
    col_edges = [-1] + vcuts + [cols]
    divider_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in hcuts} | {grid[0][c] for c in vcuts}
    colors = Counter(cell for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, cell in enumerate(row)
                     if r not in hcuts and c not in vcuts and cell != 5)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges) - 1):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == 5
                        for r in range(row_edges[ri] + 1, row_edges[ri + 1])
                        for c in range(col_edges[ci] + 1, col_edges[ci + 1]))
            out_row.append(1 if count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''

    colors = Counter(cell for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, cell in enumerate(row)
